issues: 工作台按 inline 推断只渲 95f，正好停在扫场结束帧，源码设计的 75f 深色真静止整段缺失
深色版是手抄的旧灰阶骨架 DarkDashboard，与升级后的亮色 FakeDashboard 布局、内容都对不上，扫场读作"换了一页"而不是"同一 UI 换肤"
⌘K 面板里输入的是四个深灰方块，结果行是灰条，看不出在搜什么；2px 灰边 + 单层黑影
压暗是中性 brightness 0.55，扫场边缘 5px 纯白环偏粗偏廉价
changes: 补导出 PALETTE_THEME_RIPPLE_DURATION = 170；15/22/38–62/68/73/95 全部关键帧与圆心 (960,470)、收缩完成帧=扫场起始帧的组合命门不变
删掉手抄深色版，改用同布局的 <FakeDashboard tone="dark" />，两版逐像素同构，扫场只换肤不换页
面板换成出版级命令面板：放大镜 + 真实逐字输入 "dark"（3f 浮入、强调色闪烁光标）+ ⌘K 键帽；结果行 Switch to dark theme / Match system appearance / Increase contrast 带图标，首行匹配字母随输入逐个加粗，打完进入强调色选中态与 ↵ 键帽
压暗改为冷色相径向压暗 + 去饱和 + 5px 虚化；收缩段按缩放速度给模糊；亮点加强调色辉光核
扫场边缘改 3px 亮线 + 强调色外辉 + 白色内辉，深色版随扫场 1.01→1 坐实，落定后无 transform
issuesEn: The workbench's inline guess rendered only 95f, ending exactly on the sweep's last frame, so the 75f of dark stillness designed in the source was missing

The dark version was a hand-copied old grey skeleton DarkDashboard that matches neither the layout nor the content of the upgraded light FakeDashboard, so the sweep read as a page change rather than a re-skin of the same UI
The ⌘K panel 'typed' four dark grey squares into grey-bar results, so you couldn't tell what was searched; 2px grey border and a single black shadow
The dim was a neutral brightness 0.55, and the 5px pure-white sweep ring was heavy and cheap-looking
changesEn: Exported PALETTE_THEME_RIPPLE_DURATION = 170; the 15/22/38–62/68/73/95 keyframes, the (960,470) origin and the rule that the shrink-complete frame is the sweep start frame are unchanged
Dropped the hand-copied dark version in favour of the same-layout <FakeDashboard tone="dark" />, so both versions are pixel-identical in structure and the sweep only re-skins

The panel is a publication-grade command palette: magnifier, real typed "dark" (3f rise, blinking accent caret) and a ⌘K keycap; results Switch to dark theme / Match system appearance / Increase contrast carry icons, the first row bolds each matched letter as it is typed, then takes an accent selected state with a ↵ keycap
The dim is a cool-tinted radial overlay with desaturation and 5px blur; the shrink gets scale-velocity blur; the pin dot gains an accent glow core
The sweep edge is a 3px bright line with an accent outer glow and white inner glow, and the dark layer settles 1.01→1 during the sweep with no transform once it lands
